brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two full-depth hex bins in adjacent cells: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on two joined full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full). Each bin provides an open tray for holding kitchen utensils.

The configurator checks fit/collisions only and does not verify materials, sealing, heat or dishwasher resistance. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; waterproofing and dishwasher safety depend on material/process choice outside the system, so cannot be guaranteed as met. Shape is two open-top bins with no drains, but material safety unverified.

finish.summary: Built a compact two-cell utensil holder using two full-depth bins. End caps and joint bolts applied. Waterproof/dishwasher-safe claims cannot be met by geometry alone and are unmet per house rules.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
